notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Part of the application packet (application). A 68-page scanned packet (5 MB) with a text layer, read with pypdf once downloaded in full. It holds the resource family application, a residence history form, a doctor's report, a disclosure statement for each adult, a home study document of personal questions, a direct deposit form and an IRS W-9. Questions paraphrased by hand. The second applicant's questions and repeated forms are recorded once. Signed policy acknowledgements (discipline, guns, smoking, social media, transport, car seats, appeals, clothing and full disclosure), clearance instructions and signatures are left out. Not yet checked by a person.

name: Ministry for labour: Application for approval as a foster carer (Demande d'agrément d'assistant(e) familial(e), Cerfa 13395*02)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Application for approval (demande d'agrément). National form, the same in every département: it is sent to the president of the departmental council, which runs the approval, so operator_type is local_authority. 7-page fillable PDF (metadata 2017, modified May 2018); the service-public page says it was checked on 1 April 2020. Pages 1-2 are guidance: an information meeting is strongly advised first; a medical certificate, ID and any residence permit go with the form; the council itself requests a criminal record extract (bulletin n°2) for the applicant and every adult at home, so the form asks no conviction question. A first application fills sections 1-6 and 12; renewal-only sections 7-11 are left out here. Several départements republish the same PDF (Finistère, Morbihan, Loiret, Eure, Manche, Vendée). Puy-de-Dôme links a December 2022 version with a data-protection notice; it sits behind a bot check and was not read. The census holds eight département enquiry forms for this job.

name: Département des Deux-Sèvres: Request for approval to adopt, questionnaire for applicants (Demande d'agrément en vue de l'adoption)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Request for approval to adopt: questionnaire (demande d'agrément). 4-page PDF, metadata February 2017; found by web search, and the page that links it was not checked, so whether it is still in use is unverified. Two columns, one per applicant; recorded once. Asks whether you went to an information meeting, so it follows first contact. Refers to a 'complementary sheet' on the adoption plan that is not in the file, hence partial. In France adoption approval usually starts with a letter; national guidance says a standard questionnaire is handed out at the information meeting or first interview. Haute-Garonne also publishes a request form but its robots.txt asks automated readers to stay out, so it was not read. Asks nothing on health or convictions; national rules ask for a medical certificate, a criminal record extract and proof of income alongside it.

name: Bavarian Land Youth Office (ZBFS): Questionnaire for foster and adoption applicants (Fragebogen für Pflege- und Adoptionsbewerber, Basisbogen)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Application questionnaire (Basisbogen). 7-page fillable PDF, dated 2021 in the footer, with a box for the placing office's stamp: a model form for youth welfare offices across Bavaria, found by web search. Two columns, one per applicant; recorded once. Includes a declaration, a release from confidentiality, and an annex on the child the applicants could take (5-point scales). The state office also publishes extra modules (for example on an adoptive child or an older child) that were not read. Papers to attach: life stories with photo, a doctor's certificate, an enhanced police certificate, pay slips, birth register extract and marriage certificate.

name: Jugendhilfe Hephata (Hessisches Diakoniezentrum Hephata): Questionnaire for applying as a foster family (Bewerbung als Pflegefamilie, Fragebogen)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Applicant questionnaire (Bewerbungsfragebogen). 10-page fillable PDF, version 1.11, metadata January to February 2026; found by web search. One questionnaire per adult; it says answers are a basis for later talks and that there are no right or wrong answers. Also covers people applying as a professional foster home (Erziehungsstelle). The annex asks about income and consent to tell the local youth office. Asks nothing on health or convictions. Not in the front-door register.

name: City of Wiesbaden social work office, foster care service: Application to foster (Antrag für Pflegeelternbewerber*innen)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Application to foster (Bewerbung, Antrag). 9-page fillable PDF in 7 steps, metadata December 2022, linked from the register page as the application to take a foster child. Required fields are marked with an asterisk, so required is yes or no here; step 6 (the child) has no required marks. Sent with a life story for each applicant and a joint couple story, after which the service arranges a first interview. Proof of income comes to that interview; an enhanced police certificate for every adult at home, doctor's certificates, a health self-declaration (no chronic, life-shortening, mental or infectious illness or addiction) and a declaration on pending criminal cases are given out there, so this form asks no health or conviction question. The census holds no Wiesbaden enquiry form.

name: City of Bochum youth welfare office: Applicant questionnaire for an adoptive or foster child (Bewerberfragebogen)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Applicant questionnaire (Bewerberfragebogen). 8-page fillable PDF, metadata July 2025; found by web search. Two columns, one per applicant; recorded once. Asks about convictions and serious illness of the applicants and of everyone in the household, fertility and fertility treatment, debts, and the applicants' parents and siblings. Ends with consent to police certificates, health certificates and a credit report (Schufa). Bochum is not in the front-door register.

name: Instituto Aragonés de Servicios Sociales (IASS): Request for assessment to foster a child from outside the family (Solicitud de acogimiento familiar, familia ajena)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Request for suitability assessment (solicitud de valoración de idoneidad). 3-page fillable PDF (procedure 1104), metadata February to November 2025; can also be filed on the e-office with a digital ID. The office checks attendance at the information session, identity, and the criminal and sex-offence records of the applicants and every adult at home unless they object. Health, income and (for non-Spanish applicants) record certificates are asked for as attached documents, not questions. Almost the same as the IASS adoption request.

name: Instituto Aragonés de Servicios Sociales (IASS): Request for assessment to adopt within Spain, with questionnaire (Solicitud de adopción nacional, Anexo I cuestionario)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Request for suitability assessment (solicitud de valoración de idoneidad). 9-page fillable PDF (procedure 1105), metadata February to November 2025: a 3-page request like the IASS foster request, then a 6-page official questionnaire (Anexo I) answered jointly by the couple. The page says an adoption request cannot be held at the same time as a foster request. Names and contact details repeated in the questionnaire are recorded once. Checks of criminal and sex-offence records cover every adult at home.

name: Junta de Extremadura: Request for assessment to adopt within Spain, with offer form (Solicitud de valoración para adopción nacional, Anexo II, and Solicitud de ofrecimiento)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Request for suitability assessment (solicitud de valoración). Two documents on the procedure page: the 5-page request (Anexo II, as published in the regional gazette of 7 June 2022; PDF metadata January 2025) and a 4-page offer form on the child sought (Solicitud de ofrecimiento para la adopción, scanned, metadata 2022 to January 2025). The offer form has no readable text, so its questions come from the fillable field names only, hence partial. Two columns (applicants A and B); recorded once. The doctor's report must cover everyone living permanently in the home. The register has only the Junta's foster care front door (es-ex-junta-acogimiento), so front_door_id is blank.

name: Región de Murcia, Directorate for Families and Child Protection: Request for a declaration of suitability to foster (Solicitud de declaración de adecuación para acogimiento familiar)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Request for suitability assessment (solicitud de declaración de adecuación). Word 97 document (procedure 151 in the regional services guide); found by web search. Read from the file's text, so layout and tick-box positions are approximate. Covers kinship, known adults and unrelated families, and many temporary and permanent schemes; one scheme needs a listed professional qualification. Declares that the compulsory information session was attended. A separate consent annex must be signed by every household member aged 14 or over; for permanent unrelated foster care an availability questionnaire is also needed, and it is not published, hence partial. Checks cover the sex-offence records of household members aged 14 or over.

name: Junta de Andalucía, Ministry for Social Inclusion, Youth, Families and Equality: Offer to foster (Ofrecimiento para el acogimiento familiar, procedure 11068, Anexo I)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Offer to foster (ofrecimiento). 9-page PDF, metadata January 2024, linked as 'Descargar Solicitud' on the foster care steps page. A separate annex (I bis) lets adults living in the home object to or consent to checks; it was not read. Details of an optional representative and pages on documents the administration already holds are left out. A certificate of attending the information session goes with it unless the session was in Andalusia. The kinship version is a separate one-page form, not recorded.

name: Institut Català de l'Acolliment i de l'Adopció (ICAA): Request to adopt in Catalonia (Sol·licitud d'adopció a Catalunya, IM 99020)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Request to adopt (sol·licitud d'adopció). Dynamic (XFA) PDF, form IM 99020 V1-24, metadata December 2024 to February 2025; read from the form's template, which marks required fields, so required is yes or no. Also filed online. Short: asks the reason for offering to adopt, the child's age range and the date of the ICAA information session you attended, and nothing on health, money, convictions or household members. The register front door is the ICAA page for children with special needs, which has its own request form (not recorded).

name: Halton Children's Aid Society: Homestudy application form (adoption, foster, kin and customary care)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Homestudy application. 5-page PDF, revised 30 November 2023. The page lists the steps: phone or email enquiry, then an initial home visit where the application package is given, then training and the homestudy. Two columns, one per applicant; recorded once. Asks about police contact for anyone in the home and about child protection history, and consents to a search of the provincial child protection database (CPIN). Each applicant needs their own email address. The census holds no Halton enquiry form.

name: Weechi-it-te-win Family Services: Alternative care home application
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Alternative care home application. 3-page fillable PDF, version 3/19 (March 2019), linked as 'Application Form'. Gathers details to start the caregiver home assessment with community care programmes. Two caregiver columns; recorded once. Asks for clan, First Nation and cultural identity. Asks about abuse investigations and criminal convictions for anyone in the home, and for five references (three for single applicants); a medical, a provincial child protection check and vulnerable sector screening follow. Office-use boxes left out. Asks nothing on income.

name: CISSS des Laurentides: Offer of service to become a family-type resource (Offre de service, ressource de type familial)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Offer of service (offre de service). Word form of about 25 pages, linked from the register page. Covers family-type resources for children and adults, so the child questions include adult groups. You must have registered for or attended the information evening first. Starts with the minister's general criteria (age, citizenship, no related criminal record for you and adults at home, no insolvency in three years), then a long home checklist and a full monthly budget. Sent with proof of citizenship, ID, a full credit report, and the province's 'declaration and commitment' and 'criminal record declaration' forms (one per adult at home), which are not recorded here. A medical reference form comes later. The document says reproduction is not allowed; only paraphrased questions are recorded. The census holds no Laurentides enquiry form.

name: CIUSSS de la Capitale-Nationale: Offer of service to become a foster family (Offre de service pour devenir famille d'accueil, ressource de type familial)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Offer of service (offre de service). 11-page fillable PDF, updated 10 April 2024 (metadata 2022 to 2024); about 9.7 MB. You declare that you watched the information session slides first. Includes a 'mixed bank' option to foster with a view to adopt. Asks about health, therapy, substance use, convictions, insolvency and a full budget, and asks about criminal records and health of other adults at home and youth-protection follow-up of your children. The same page links the province's criminal record declaration and declaration and commitment forms (2020) and reference forms for employers, friends, doctors, teachers and daycares; those are not recorded. The census holds no Capitale-Nationale enquiry form.

name: Government of the Northwest Territories, Health and Social Services: Foster home application (Child and Family Services form 7.3.2)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Foster home application. Form 7.3.2, 3 pages inside a 130-page PDF of section 7 forms from the Child and Family Services standards and procedures manual (metadata January 2021). The page link opens the PDF directly; it is about 5.6 MB. Short: one combined block for applicants, with a single question on health. Says a consent to release information, a medical examination report, a criminal record and vulnerable sector check for every adult at home, an interprovincial child protection check and three references are needed first, and that a home study follows within 45 days. Other forms in the PDF are not recorded.

name: MercyCare Fostering Services: Foster carer application form
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Foster carer application. 12-page Word form, uploaded July 2021; found by web search, and the page that links it was not checked, so whether it is current is unverified. Part 1 is for applicant 1, Part 2 repeats it for applicant 2, and Part 3 is joint; Part 2 is recorded once as a single row. Has a long health checklist, a doctor's details, smoking and alcohol, child protection contact for the family, a criminal question, and children's health. Says criminal and child protection record checks will be done. The WA government's guide says its own application pack comes after a home visit or phone interview. MercyCare is not in the front-door register.

name: Pathfinders Out of Home Care Services: Foster care registration of interest form and applicant health checklist
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Registration of interest (step 2, before the home visit and the application). 5-page PDF, March 2023, linked from step 2 of the 'how to become a foster carer' page; an online version of the same form is at pathfinders.ngo/referrals/foster-care-complete-form/. The page puts this after the first enquiry and before the home visit and step 4 (application and screening), so it sits between the two stages. Required is taken from the online version's markers where it has them; the online health section has no smoking, alcohol or drug questions, which the PDF has. Each applicant fills a separate health checklist; recorded once. The census holds the Pathfinders enquiry form (au-nsw-pathfinders-enquiry).

name: Queensland Department of Families, Seniors, Disability Services and Child Safety, Adoption and Permanent Care Services: Adoption expression of interest (Form 6)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Step: Expression of interest (entry on the register, before selection for assessment). 22-page PDF, Form 6 version 6 under the Adoption Act 2009; metadata 2018 to December 2025. A guide to completing it is published alongside. Part A decides entry on the Expression of Interest Register (eligibility includes not being pregnant and not being in a surrogacy arrangement); Part B is used to select people for assessment. The longest form read here. Two columns (person 1 and 2); recorded once. Asks about criminal, traffic and domestic violence history, household members' history, child protection contact, detailed health and fertility, height and weight, family medical history and money for intercountry costs. All adult household members sign. Queensland's foster carer forms (for example the Form 3A application for initial approval) are hosted on sites that refused our reader with 403, so none was read.

name: Warrington Borough Council, on the Foster4 hub site: Expression of interest form for the No Wrong Door roles (hub community carer or supported lodgings host)
notes: Application form added by applications_to_census.py: Public online form, read from the page HTML; questions paraphrased. The page has a short general enquiry form and this longer form; only the longer one is recorded. It is filled in before any meeting, yet it asks for consent to initial council checks, from you and from every other adult in the home, so it sits closer to an application than an enquiry. It is for two roles in Warrington's No Wrong Door model: hub community carer (fostering) and supported lodgings host. Questions about health, convictions, social services and former partners are optional on the form. Blocks repeated for the second applicant are recorded once. Typed-name and date boxes left out. The page gives no date. If the census keeps first contact and application apart, this may fit better as a first-contact form. Counted as an application because it asks for consent to council checks for every adult in the home; it is filled in before any meeting.
